about: The one registry of the event log: every family and every kind a row may have. The mod reads it at start (Shared/EventLog.lua) and refuses a row of any other kind; the host reads the same file (embedded in GateKit.Bridge) to check, merge and filter rows. Adding a family is an entry here plus the code that writes its rows. docs/contracts/bridge-protocol.md, "The event log".
